ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar_v3.json is FanGraphs' published WAR from the frozen vintage plus the site's named departures; it moves only when it is rebuilt by hand.

dollars_per_war_source: value_framework.dollars_per_war_flat(), the level the Trade Machine calibration reports as dpw_level_usd
note: Per-stint season WAR on the displayed eWAR v2 basis for every Trade Machine player. A stint frame has no calendar dates: the page credits a receiving club only the stints that follow the sending club's stint in the trade season, and every stint in later seasons. Rows are [season, club, stint, side, war] with side 0 batting and 1 pitching. No row means no MLB time.
